title: README.md should make a recommendation on the Anthropic model to use for the demo
description: I recommend we direct people to a particular Anthropic model to select while doing the demo. I've found the Claude 3.5 Sonnet v models to be worse for this activity, and Claude 4 based models better.

title: Correction for Python uv environment setup in README.md
description:
- In the README.md...
- expand the Prerequisites for running on your own machine...
- under the section **Python demo pre-requisites**...
- in step 2 **Create a virtual environment for this project**...
- in sub-step `ii` _Select Venv or uv as the environment type and pick a base interpreter_

...it explains that you can choose different virtual environments. If you select `uv`, then sub-step `iii` it says to select `requirements.txt` in the dropdown offered in the ui - but this is not shown for `uv` (it is only shown for `Venv`).

Currently, you would need to manually install those requirements, such as in the terminal or using a magic in the Console.
